instruction: A candid documentary wide shot from a slightly high angle shows an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. On the left, the bearded man in a black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands with his back to the camera, holding the face of the woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) with both of his hands. The woman (R2) stands on the right, facing left with a neutral expression as she looks at the man. The background contains technical equipment and tripods. The scene is illuminated by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
elements: R1 holds R2's face with both hands
R2 is the person whose face is being held by R1
R2 faces and looks at R1 while R1 holds her face
R1 has his back to the camera during the face-holding contact
